description:
Partially update a roadmap milestone. milestone accepts a milestone id or slug (scoped to the property's board). Provide any combination of name, description, startDate, endDate (YYYY-MM-DD), color (#RRGGBB). A scheduled milestone can be moved but never unscheduled (dates cannot be blanked), and the resulting startDate must stay <= endDate. Assigning tasks or milestone dependencies is done elsewhere.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// push the Q3 milestone's end date out by two weeks.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","milestone":"q3-launch","endDate":"2026-10-15"}
```
name: update_milestone
title: Update milestone
